items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: There's Grover Washington, Jr. I heard some of the things he did recently.

ctx.x: Thad Bad Jones, Mel Lewis. They were leading. Then there's Toshiko and Lew Tabackin-- their band is pretty heavy. That's the big band. There's Grover Washington, Jr. I heard some of the things he did recently.
Well, they've ganna change. As the times change, you think they will change.
